name: edit_file
description: Edits an existing file by replacing a specific section of text (targetContent) with a new section (replacementContent). The target section must match the file exactly.

path.description: The path of the file to edit.

targetContent.description: The exact block of text to find and replace (including whitespace and newlines).

replacementContent.description: The new block of text to insert in place of targetContent.
